notes.title: Meet the Vixens!
notes.content:
[p]Meet the Vixens, a new enemy type we’re currently developing – fast, coordinated, and unlike anything else in the game. [/p][p]Unlike the brute strength of the Ursa, the Vixens are all about [b]speed, finesse, and deception[/b]. They’re agile, tactical, and not afraid to fight dirty. Once they’re in, you’ll need quick reactions to survive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/23dbadc410ec3d920e85073ad58834bf3df23329.gif"][/img][/p][p]Here are the four Vixen archetypes joining the fray:[/p][list][*][p][b]Vixen Duelist[/b] – An agile rogue with [b]Twin Daggers[/b], capable of quick strikes and evasive movements[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vixen Spearmaiden[/b] – A nimble [b]Polearm user[/b] who keeps her distance but punishes any misstep[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vixen Shieldmaiden[/b] – A tactical fighter who uses her [b]Shield[/b] not only for defense but for sudden bashes and counters[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vixen Knife Thrower[/b] – A ranged unit who peppers the battlefield with [b]deadly throwing knives[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/4ed6c594bd512186791514cecee1abe0e3d34583.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/41d70a5eec9dadad1e6f059825029ed722e5e7aa.png"][/img][/p][p]These enemies may not be as physically imposing as the Ursa, but make no mistake – [b]they are every bit as dangerous[/b]. They’ll use [b]feints, combos, and terrain[/b] to their advantage. Our advice: don’t get suckered in by their dashing looks or their games – or you’ll be sliced and diced in seconds.[/p][p]Let us know what you think! Which do you find more dangerous – the brute force of the Ursa or the cunning agility of the Vixens?[/p][p]Thanks for being part of the journey![/p]

notes.title: New enemy type — Ursa
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Just a quick update from the dev team — we’re actively working on new content, and today we’re sharing a look at a new enemy faction in development for the Winter biome – the [b]Ursa[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/0636f4c0bf1c130c71f1ed0e701155b9fc5a60a9.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]New Enemy Type – Ursa[/b][/p][p]The Ursa are aggressive and resilient enemies, adapted to harsh, frozen environments. We’re working on several distinct enemy types to bring more variety and tactical depth to future battles:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ursa Brawler[/b] – Wields a [b]Giant Club[/b] for crushing melee attacks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ursa Shieldbearer[/b] – A [b]Heavy Shield[/b] unit capable of soaking damage and protecting allies[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ursa Halberdier[/b] – A brutal mid-range foe with a [b]Halberd[/b] for punishing reach[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ursa Rock Thrower[/b] – Provides ranged support by hurling massive rocks from afar[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/e21010d1d90461638543f72922b9510ec2c8c9ca.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’re also working on two powerful elite units:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ursa Rogue[/b] – A savage [b]elite berserker[/b] that wields [b]Dual Axes[/b], capable of executing deadly combo attacks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ursa Brute[/b] – A [b]hulking behemoth[/b] who uses a [b]Battering Ram[/b] as a weapon to unleash devastating area-of-effect attacks[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/102fa92c0bc8b791caba83abbb9f115a55238361.png"][/img][/p][p]We’d love to hear what you think of the new enemies – which one do you think will be the most fun (or toughest) to face once the game is live?[/p][p]More updates are on the way – stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: New Biome – The Swamp
notes.content: [p]We’ve reached a big milestone in worldbuilding: the [b]Swamp biome[/b] is officially in development![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/d082b73d76ac737222ec90ef127bd53fdbc6ffe5.gif"][/img][/p][p]This will be a completely new environment to explore, learn, and eventually battle through. The Swamp is designed to feel fresh and mysterious – full of [b]deadly creatures[/b], [b]unfamiliar layouts[/b], and [b]unique challenges[/b] tied to its waterlogged terrain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/8d7f0df1c938a96d31a02874eef1b210eec73d41.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/91f50931f7c76453442ca2a620fa2cf7b3cb2694.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/fac2676c937d595df3298b4feb2d25087891111c.png"][/img][/p][p]Just like with the Winter biome, [b]this is only the beginning[/b]. The Swamp will keep evolving as development continues – with new enemies, events, encounters, and rewards planned ahead. Stay alert... because the [b]next danger might rise right out of the water.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Dev Diaries: Building mechanics
notes.content:
Today, we're excited to share how a key feature— [b]Building[/b] — has evolved and what new possibilities are now available to you.

At the start, we focused on the fundamental building blocks: foundations, walls, roofs, and other essential components for creating your unique home. However, as the mechanics developed, we realized that building needed to be more than just functional—it needed to be flexible. This led to the introduction of adjustable-height foundations, opening up new possibilities for multi-level structures and intricate landscape designs.
We also added a visual boundary that clearly shows where you can build. This feature has become super helpful for planning, especially when you start large-scale construction on your island and every inch of space counts. The circular building zone makes it easy to swap islands without having to rebuild everything from scratch. Originally, we wanted to make the whole island available for building, but the circular zone ended up being a better choice for flexibility and convenience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/a194dd4cca73f9e247444175bda8469a9c78145d.gif[/img]
[i]What the game looked like when the building mechanic was invented[/i]

One of the most important aspects of building is the ability to move objects around. We understood that sometimes you might want to change the placement of already installed items, so we made this process as simple and intuitive as possible. Now, you can rearrange objects to redesign your home or garden just the way you like it.
We also introduced a system that checks for object connections when removing items. No more worries about leaving something floating in mid-air—our system automatically ensures everything stays in place. This improvement has made the building process more logical and realistic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/633e1d5fcb103ce836a8c97c7f8e97b6d7cf4ca5.png[/img]
[i]And as you can see, a lot of work has been done, and various construction elements have been created[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/a331daf15ec001722f74db5f34aa087ebc11060d.jpg[/img]

Visual appeal has always been a priority for us, and we strive to make every moment in the game not only engaging but also good-looking. That’s why we've added new visual effects and completely overhauled the look of the basic building elements, adding more detail and realism. Now, your home or garden feels even cozier and more complete.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/bd66b87ef20d800b91a8737c2522b4853874861f.png[/img]
[i]This is how “old houses” looked like[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/b6300d982a6db4077c6b5bc294648a12b95fcaa0.jpg[/img]
[i]After visual upgrades[/i]

As we developed the building mechanics, we expanded the range of available elements in various sizes, giving you even more freedom to create unique designs. Now, you can experiment with sizes and shapes, finding the perfect solutions for every corner of your island.
From the very beginning, we thought through a system of permits and prohibitions for placing objects such as rugs, wall lights, paintings and the like. This avoids mistakes in the placement of furniture and other decorative elements. We continue to work on this system to make the construction process as convenient and comfortable as possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/083798446621608bc9530cf6e24a92abdc13354c.png[/img]

With each update, we aim to make the building process more engaging, convenient, and creative. We thank you for your inspiration and support!

notes.title: Dev Diaries: the Winter Biome
notes.content:
Murrlandia is a great, fractured world that once united various biomes. After the Cat-A-Strophe, some biomes changed, giving rise to new, previously non-existent locations. The Winter Biome is one of these new worlds and has become a key part of our project that our developers are actively working on.

[h2]Beginning of Development[/h2]
Work on the Winter Biome began at the earliest stages of development. During the prototyping of the visual aspects of the islands, we had numerous sketches of various biomes and experimented with the mood of the locations. Some of these ideas have already been implemented in recent updates, while others require more time for thorough development.
We periodically revisited the Winter Biome and even planned to start its development simultaneously with the Summer Biome. However, we realized that it required more time and attention to achieve the desired level of quality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/e2f82677a478149ef4a255980e61cc629a636f87.png[/img]

[h2]Inspiration and Concepts[/h2]
For the visual concept of the Winter Biome, we drew inspiration from northern regions with their natural features, adapted for a sky-floating world. The concepts for the Winter Biome included elements of such landscapes but with a magical and mysterious touch characteristic of Murrlandia.

[h2]Atmosphere Through Graphics[/h2]
Creating the atmosphere of the Winter Biome through graphics was a challenging but exciting process. Besides the snow covering the ground, we used many new and unique effects. The air temperature in the frosty region affects everything around: clouds become heavier and denser, weather effects change, and sunlight takes on a special hue, creating the feel of a cold winter fairy tale.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/e003e45a322a1dfa6575d3ded55ddd13b949b4a2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Asset Use and Content Development[/h2]
The winter islands in the WorldShards universe are part of the overall world, so we prepare a lot of new content and adapt familiar objects that have spent a long time in the new region. On the winter islands, players will encounter familiar Wargs, who have set up their camps and outposts in an unusual environment for them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/cdc8f24d62e97a36d25d11c285f34f659d9774e1.gif[/img]
We also continue to work on remastering existing content, which will gradually be replaced with higher quality and more detailed versions.

[h2]Challenges and Solutions[/h2]
Creating a true winter atmosphere was not an easy task. Simply painting the ground white to create a snow effect was insufficient. We studied the visual impact of snow from the observer's perspective and developed a special shader that gives the snow all the necessary soft shades, regardless of lighting, with a magical shimmer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/91c211d8e97334d6caeccd4e06980bc7b7a83127.jpg[/img]

[h2]Weather Effects[/h2]
The Winter biome will feature corresponding weather effects on certain islands, providing a dynamic and engaging atmosphere for players to explore.
We have a method for creating and testing various weather effects, which we plan to significantly improve in the future. We can't disclose all the details yet, but stay tuned for updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/969fd160c8d472b76329cb31323d17034c6e09bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Difficulties
[/h2]One of the most challenging aspects of development was correctly assessing our capabilities and choosing the most important and necessary elements from a multitude of ideas. Each task is a challenge for us, and for each, we learn and apply new knowledge, approaches, and methods.

The development of the Winter Biome continues, and the team eagerly awaits the opportunity to share their achievements with players (trust us, it's coming soon). We continue to improve and develop this cold world so that every player can feel the beauty and magic of the Winter Biome of Murrlandia!

notes.title: Dev Diary: The Wargs
notes.content:
In today’s developer diary, we want to tell you about the path of the Wargs: who they are, how they appeared in the project, and maybe give you some useful gameplay tips. Be sure to read to the end!

[h2]History and Origin[/h2]
For those who don’t know, Wargs are the antagonists in Murrlandia’s story, arriving from a harsh, resource-poor world in search of a new home. Upon discovering the abundant Mana Stones, blue crystals used by the peaceful Meowkles for magic, the Wargs opened a portal to bring their army into Murrlandia. They fortified their position around a massive Mana Stone, led by their ruthless queen. When the Meowkle mages tried to destroy this stone and close the portal, the resulting explosion shattered Murrlandia into thousands of islands and scattered the Mana Stone fragments across the universe. These fragments retained their magical properties, transporting any living creature that touched them back to Murrlandia, thus maintaining a connection between the worlds.

[h2]Creating the Wargs[/h2]
Once we gathered enough assets, we started creating the enemies for the game. We tried different designs until we decided that we wanted the Wargs to look like large, massive wolves and started bringing this idea to life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/7d82e9b317f5314ae6f9286772776e8c62d925ac.png[/img]

Yes, this is how the Wargs looked in the initial stage. There was a lot of work ahead, but we were already on the right track.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/d1081124661645d1786d60982557db520a7e5fdf.png[/img]

We kept working and the Brutes, Rogues, and Recruits were the first to appear in the project. They differ in combat difficulty and hierarchy in the animal army.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/ed934a6675f3e0ce4ed284a56e467710bd8d73a0.png[/img]

The work on the wargs is still ongoing. We are creating new enemies for you so that your gameplay experience becomes more engaging. Check out this serious guy here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/06b405ae11f0c2a25b505c6280103172d7bdb9f1.gif[/img]

[h3]Warg Recruits[/h3]
Wargs are smart, wolf-like humanoids. The recruits are their basic soldiers and do a lot of simple jobs. You can find them wandering around wild islands, guarding important places, or staying in camps. If you kill them, they drop valuable items. They have a few basic attacks and are tougher and stronger than big animals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/64afd79d9c15030e419986da9a0678d1cbb1fcc4.png[/img]

[h3]Warg Rogues[/h3]
Warg Rogues are quick and dangerous warriors. They do special missions for the Warg Queen but often hang out on the islands while recruits do the basic work. You can find them roaming the wild islands, guarding important places, or staying in camps. If you kill them, they drop valuable items. They have a few basic attacks and some deadly combos. They are the fastest Wargs and have more health and damage than Warg Recruits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/425522f0cd0f8d6056899f574bf027f66c062660.png[/img]

[h3]Warg Brutes[/h3]
Warg Brutes are big, heavily armed warriors who lead the groups and give orders. You can find them roaming the wild islands, guarding important places, or staying in camps. If you kill them, they drop valuable items. They have a few basic attacks, deadly combos, and powerful heavy attacks. They are the toughest and strongest Wargs, with more health and damage than Warg Rogues.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/1d5918758d85a276990557207cde22222dcb3acb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Animation[/h2]
Currently, we are mainly working on creating animations in Maya. The main focus is on making the character setup as high-quality as possible, ensuring that all animation elements move naturally and correctly. During setup, it’s important to carefully analyze the characters, imagine the movements they could make, and choose interesting poses according to the concept.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/b449c70f4e2386cd5af8b1879600006f40870311.jpg[/img]

After sketching the animations, we move on to timing the movements to better convey the sense of action. Then, we smooth out the movements, add details, and perfect the animations. Various specialized scripts are actively used in this process, significantly simplifying the work.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/6f05ebb51b0fc4f713499700008986af7007d263.gif[/img]

Working on animations often involves technical difficulties. Our animators consider the specifics of game engines, the peculiarities of bone animation, and constantly keep optimization and game mechanics in mind.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/a9b402161cc0108b534d156d330e74758e393ba4.gif[/img]

[h3]And here’s a tip for you:[/h3]
Use combat consumables in tough or large-scale battles with the Wargs. Remember that meat-based food can heal you in battle. Read the attacks correctly and dodge them, fight the Wargs with appropriate gear and weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/7658658f06aeb266fec9dcafd3690639649a4b71.png[/img]

Working on the Wargs in the Murrlandia is a process of constant improvements and changes. We strive to create interesting and memorable opponents that make the gameplay exciting and engaging. We hope our players appreciate the effort and attention to detail put into each Warg. And who knows, maybe someone new will show up soon. Only time will tell…

notes.title: Dev Diaries: Graphics Update
notes.content:
[h3]Adventurers, we continue our journey into upgrading the graphical elements of our environment, moving away from generic and low-poly assets.[/h3]

To give you the full picture, let’s start from the beginning. As we said, we purchased ready-made assets. We acquired various materials to test our ideas. At this stage, we created gray prototypes based on concepts and experimented with low-poly models with simple textures. This was essential to quicken the game’s development. Now, let’s share what came out of this process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/6bb9dafe91da1ab300d304728d9adfee7abfca7d.png[/img]

Right from the start, after purchasing the ready-made assets, we faced the need for significant adjustments in materials, scales, and styles of the assets themselves. This led to our first experiments in creating locations and visual effects, which allowed us to quickly do a playable island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/57cda222985480a2ff0633080ba22d0f3b507185.png[/img]

While our work on locations progressed successfully, we encountered challenges with character models due to our inexperience with low-poly modeling. The process of creating characters requested time and effort, especially when attempting to adjust stylized concepts into 3D. Turned out, making characters look like actual characters and not geometric nightmares is harder than it sounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/7883d0d826826a2d69a44c77a8534404783c860e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/8649c91e3a227cb60946b73bf58af1c378ea948d.png[/img]

We realized that working with low-poly models did not achieve the desired effect. This raised the question: why stick to a style that fails to impress if switching to high-poly models can improve visual quality without genuinely extending development time? Therefore, we decided to complicate our character models by adding more polygons and abandoning low-poly stylization, while still maintaining our 3D art style. Surprisingly, this step allowed us to speed up the art production process and improve the game’s visual quality. It’s important to note that we are not abandoning ready-made assets and will use them as sketches for further refinement.

Well, how about this transformation from pig to warg? And you wouldn’t recognize Farro anymore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/a1dace2326915f9731618e54362601003388f9fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/530f042a8d51f8387f050c2850b1b65792c6b262.png[/img]

Recently, we have made significant strides in content development, creating new character models, armor, weapons, and upgrading environments and visual effects. Our journey in evolving our art process and optimization continues, and we are confident in the direction we’ve chosen. Not one step back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/fad8e64eefa8d57ec15fe0bf9f827f68f2e861db.png[/img]

However, there’s still much to be done: from location update and creating new islands to improving animations and working on finer details. Our mission? To take the WorldShards game world to the next level!

[b]Stay tuned for the next Dev Diaries![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/5c262e88e4e14fb8800cb7fca3ded3937a2cbc97.gif[/img]

notes.title: From the Workshop to the Game World: Creating New Weapons
notes.content:
[h2]Ready, adventurers? [/h2]

Yes, it’s been a while, but we’re finally bringing back [b]Dev Diaries[/b]. And we have a lot to show you! We’re excited to take you behind the scenes and share the journey we’ve been on. Get ready.

Everything began with purchasing ready-made assets. Yes, imagine that — we bought a bunch of stuff to feel out the idea. At this stage, we created gray prototypes based on concepts, experimented with low-poly models with simple textures, but something was missing. Finally, we decided to switch to PBR (Physically Based Rendering) models, and that’s where the real magic began.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/8e0f0e01570db64c1e4d7fe6d3b473ee560f68bd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/4d61a7ad80ba0bd2bd020a3f83e8377302f6747e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/50f559b5fbb5688582c63b7d2f24d795b9573f4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/7e1578eb2e90b599d2e0f42627d151a13bcc44f1.png[/img]

[h2]What inspired us?[/h2]
Our concepts are inspired by games from masters like Darksiders, Battle Chasers, and Ruined King. We aimed to convey the same brightness and dynamism that attract players so much. And yes, Wayfinder was also an influence! Big thanks to Joe Madureira for his amazing visual style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/7c375c96c822a7a250d2f836acff07eca03380aa.png[/img]

[h2]Technical Tricks[/h2]
In our work process, we used Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, and Photoshop. There are many different programs, each suited to its own task. And we learned to draw highlights on blades in our own way: instead of traditional painting in the material, we baked them from the geometry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/9d9ffaeea963101f806192a15abff0fec1b31080.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/5fdc96bcf5f6926accf0485a07120f14d0f6296c.png[/img]

[h2]Changes and Improvements[/h2]
Switching to the PBR pipeline was a significant step in improving the quality of our models. Concepts initially created for low-poly models were adapted to the new style.
Moreover, we refined the texture painting process. Previously, we stuck to the original colors from the concepts, but then decided to use richer and more vibrant colors for high-level items. This decision gave our models a more premium look and helped better distinguish the rarity of items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/4d9ac44ea0b0285cc5edcfebcae8df3c9d202aa7.png[/img]

[h2]Feedback and Adjustments[/h2]
Feedback from senior artists and game designers was extremely important. The first 3–4 models went through thorough checks and adjustments, especially in terms of painting. Game designers made corrections to ensure the models met technical requirements and intended dimensions. We learned on the go and improved with each new model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/f4165486d013e9beba3a0663b7315943b322e7e8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/3e5207b5e1279935ee7be27709953c780444680f.gif[/img]

[h2]What makes it unique?[/h2]
While these items do not have superior base stats compared to regular ones, they can be repaired and upgraded with in-game currency, allowing them to be used at higher levels of play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/29e2f1c7d6ee2dc8f3020a1e6dbff6c7ba1f7972.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the result of our work and appreciate every detail. Stay tuned for updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/b18d516efeacc830633f861a2996c66daefbc808.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/8db7d52e589dd2d97c8e68de3fd46f81f78dca51.png[/img]

notes.title: WorldShards DevBlog - Graphics Update
notes.content:
Hi folks!

It’s been a while since our last update on WorldShard’s development journey, so we decided to show the highlights of what we’ve been working on so far. Hope you’ll enjoy this paw-tasic dive into WorldShards!

This spring we put together [b]the first playable build[/b], showcased it at the MEFCC, GDC, & Unity Developer Day, allowing us to gather lots of valuable feedback and impressions. Though this version of the game is not public (stay tuned — when the time comes, we’ll let you know about the public demo and its dates), the work on the next version is in full swing. Right now however, we want to show you the ways in which WorldShards has already transformed.

One of the most important visual aspects in any game is the main character. After all, the environment changes while you wander around the game's world, but your character is constantly there, a focal point on your screen.

If you’ve seen some of our earlier snapshots, you may have noticed that we used a low-poly approach for the models. However, we never intended to have this in the final version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/0be4d4e090c5cd2067e70fff98244ddbce228a80.jpg[/img]
[i]Looking back at the models - how they used to look and the way they are now! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/c8e7140f546dcd747cfa9a7cba72434b6209ab7a.jpg[/img]

So, what do we want WorldShards to look like? We find a special charm in [b]the low-poly visuals[/b], so we’re not going to fully abandon it, but we’ll be giving the game [b]an extra layer of detail[/b] making it look a lot more high-definition. 

Check out this comparison to see what we mean!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/906648dbe78c0a084e9fcd29e1af1d2585bf8273.jpg[/img]

This is just a glimpse of the many improvements we've made. But have you ever wondered how these changes look from our side? Let us show you the creation process of two 3D models – the Warg and one of our crafting stations. Seeing each step of the iterative process and the evolution is clear as day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/544c7fda207e6e831304bfa51f50d8e5a5ad0e0e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/0d53e0afb086841d06f7269d466e4b6bc2173148.jpg[/img]
[i]By the way, can you guess what this crafting station is used for?[/i]

So, what graphical improvements are we currently working on?
[list]
[*] Environment (from the lighting to the flower textures)
[*] Models (player, enemies, animals) and animations (movement, idles, attacks, etc.)
[*] VFX (spells, abilities, environmental, etc.)
[/list]

And as a parting gift, we want to give you one last teaser. Besides graphical improvements, we've been working on a bunch of [b]new features[/b] for WorldShards. For example, crafting equipment and building player housing. We're really excited about these features and can't wait to share more with you!
You can keep up to date by [url=https://twitter.com/WorldShardsGame]following us on Twitter[/url] or [url=discord.gg/pyfCtJc93c]joining our Discord server[/url] for more news and [b]daily updates[/b]!

notes.title: WorldShards at GDC
notes.content:
[b]Hello there everyone![/b]

GDC2023 is well and truly underway and we’re having a blast! What’s more, Thursday 23 (yesterday) was the first day that we were able to showcase the game at the event and get to know what people thought of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/18fac81c73f9ef69c4c23c5ada229d344b8c7caf.jpg[/img]

[h2]WorldShards at GDC[/h2]
One of the best parts of an event like the GDC is the first-hand reactions that we can get to the game. Sometimes people just want to hear about the game’s concept, so throughout the event, Artyom, our Game Designer, has perfected describing the game.

[quote][i]To us, WorldShards is a cross of Animal Crossing and Albion online with a lot of resources to gather and loot to craft. The game lets you play in many different ways, whether you want to take on a stealthy route and sneak by everyone, aggressively kill and destroy hostile creatures, or even take the peaceful route, build a reputation with the creatures and thus gain the ability to travel through the islands unscathed. Our main focus is on player immersion, we want to give out players a chance to properly express themselves when playing, and feel really comfortable while doing so![/i][/quote]

Other times, people want to have a more hands-on experience. After all, nothing beats actually playing the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/3c8f963f1b216b068b674d1c2aa5d90c598b9586.png[/img]

So far, we’ve seen a lot of people having fun playing the game and we’ve had some great conversations with both gamers and developers (this is the Game Developers Conference after all). Right now we’re looking forward to what the final day (Friday 24th) will bring us!

[h2]WorldShards Trailer[/h2]
Check out our trailer to see the game for yourself!

[previewyoutube=aRGhFXFQmXQ;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all for now, but don't worry, we'll be back soon with a much more in-depth write-up of GDC2023 and what we've experienced there!

Stay up to date with WorldShards, by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/WorldShardsGame]Twitter[/url], liking us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/L1523Kick/]Facebook[/url], and joining our [url=https://discord.gg/pyfCtJc93c]Discord server[/url]. notes.title: Meet the Team - WorldShards Interviews
notes.content:
Hello there everyone,

Development on WorldShards continues to go from strength to strength, and we’re excited to see new features make their way into the game, and for the existing features to undergo constant improvement. 

Looking back at our past articles and news posts, we’ve focused on drip-feeding you snippets of the game’s lore and what you can expect from the game, but there’s one very important thing that we’ve not yet started, introducing the team, so we’re sure that you can guess what we’re doing today!

So without further ado, let’s start off the first WorldShards team introductions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/d5b8e843ab610ae27c94428d15027d5fc94d1b18.png[/img]

[h1]Nikita Nikitin - Producer[/h1]
[b]Thank you very much for joining us today, we’re really excited to be able to start introducing the WorldShards team to our fledgling community!

Let’s start with an introduction, can you tell us your name, and what your position is within WorldShards? And please do go into detail if you can, the more you can say, the better![/b]

[i]Great, let’s get things started, my name is Nikita Nikitin, and I am a producer with LowKick, working on WorldShards.

As for what that entails, I am in charge of the overall creative vision of the game, so I find myself immersed in pretty much all parts of the development processes and also the game’s design department. On a day-to-day basis, I deal with planning, making sure the documentation is created properly, (so it’s my duty to make sure that roadmaps, feature lists, and content plans are written) and actively provide feedback to the art teams. I guess you can think of it as having a finger in pretty much every pie.

For what I really like and dislike, I would say that I really enjoy looking at newly implemented mechanics and exploring if-and-how they can be improved on in the next iteration. What I dislike should be quite predictable for someone in my position, it’s when things don’t go to plan.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/858679946abbc84889bec41e71d3ee9e9613ffb3.jpg[/img]

[b]That’s a great introduction, it seems to me that you’re like the gel that keeps the teams working together smoothly! I’ve noticed that the producer role is quite often misunderstood, so it’s great to learn about the role straight from you!

This does bring me nicely to my next question, it’s clear to me that you’re quite experienced, so if you can tell us, what were you working on before you joined WorldShards? And as a bonus question, of all your past jobs, what was your most memorable?[/b]

[i]You’re right that I have worked on previous projects, and I can even say that the previous project included many members of the LowKick team. Unfortunately, because of an existing NDA, I can’t name it. What I can say is that it was a very ambitious project, but unfortunately, it had to close down, when that happened I moved to LowKick and started my work on WorldShards.

As for the previous job that left the biggest impression, I would say it was with Game Insight as that was the start of my journey into the world of Game Development. It was there that I met many good people, some of whom I work with now at LowKick. 

While there, we made Guns of Boom, a successful mobile FPS. This was a game that is very close to me as it was a project that I was with from the very beginning and got to be involved in all stages of the game’s development.

Game Insight provided me with a lot of useful experience in how to do things, and also how not to do things![/i]

[b]So I was right, you certainly are experienced. I completely understand why you went for Guns of Boom, the first game that one works on from start to finish is special!

With such a background, how did you first hear about WorldShards, and how did you end up joining them?[/b]

[i]I’m actually one of the original creators of WorldShards! The concept itself was born about five years ago, and all this time the concept grew with different ideas on what we wanted to see in WorldShards, and what the players would (hopefully) enjoy. So I was part of the project from the very-very beginning and we ended up using all of the ideas that we came up with during that time![/i]

[b]That’s great, so you’re a true founder (among others) for WorldShards! So with such a personal connection to the game, what is it that really calls out to you?[/b]

[i]Personally speaking, it would be the opportunity to spend your free time on this project with friends, building, mining resources, trading, and generally performing group activities.

Of the planned features, I find stealth to be very appealing and because of this, we’ve designed large, open locations like the Warg settlements in which the player will need to use stealth to properly explore, especially if you want to find all the secrets and secret loot![/i]

[b]Well that sounds fantastic, it’s really surprising but in my experience, it’s quite hard to find a game that really balances all of those features that you mentioned, so just hearing that from you makes me rather excited.

Continuing on with my questions on the game and your connection to it, WorldShards has already introduced a lot of unique characters and species, so what would you say is your favourite?

And, we’ve got a fun question for you. If you find yourself in a situation where you are being summoned to the universe of WorldShards, and you can be reborn as a race from WorldShards, who/what would you be?[/b]

[i]Ok, I like the Wargs the best! They are a race that emerged into the world of WorldShards, have an uneasy fate, and have to somehow navigate a plethora of internal conflicts. Also, *spoiler alert* though they may be the bad guys who have come to take over the world, not all of the Wargs are aggressive and want to wage war against the Meowkles, some genuinely want to just find a new home to replace their destroyed homeworld.

As for the reborn question, if I could be reborn in Murrlandia, I’d actually want to be a big ginger Meowkle who mentors and guides the heroes who arrive in this world, that way, in my spare time I can simply eat and sleep - living the dream![/i]

[b]At first, I was surprised you chose Meowkle, given that you like the Wargs the best, but after hearing your reason for it, I can totally see why. In a way, it sounds like a more relaxed producer role, helping guide and gel the others, but actually having some time to rest in the meantime!

So, now we’re coming to the end of this interview, I’d like to end this with a bit about you as a person.

What would you say your hobbies are outside of working on games?[/b]

[i]Gaming, in one form or another, plays a big part in my life. I do play other games, read about games, and watch people play games on streams. Outside of the digital world, I occasionally play the guitar and paint Warhammer miniatures.[/i]

[b]As you’re a big gamer, let’s make the final question about that. What would you say is your favourite genre and your favourite game?[/b]

[i]I really enjoy Survival games, but honestly, I don’t exclude a genre, I’m happy to play games from every genre! As for my favourite, one of my favourites would be Don’t Starve Together, and thanks to its many interesting mechanics, I consider it to be one of the best games of its genre.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/d5b8e843ab610ae27c94428d15027d5fc94d1b18.png[/img]

And that's all for our first interview, we hope that you've all enjoyed reading along and getting to know Nikita!

Now, as we prepare for the next interview, it's over to you - our community - do you have any questions for Nikita? If so, do let us know and we'll do our best to get the answers for you!

notes.title: A look at WorldShards!
notes.content:
Hello there everyone!

WorldShards is happy to welcome 2023, and what better way to do so than by diving into what WorldShards looks like today, give you a little information on what we’re working towards (yes, it’s game design exploration time) and a look at the some of the progress that we’ve achieved so far!

So, join us on this paw-tasic dive into WorldShards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/f10bc255bc0619b1c53c06390e6603f01ad8d8a5.png[/img]

[h1]WorldShards Today![/h1]

First thing first, let’s showcase what WorldShards looks like today. Just remember, this is all very early days - to the extent that features, models, and even game mechanics tend to change by the week, - our devs are doing amazing work every week!

[previewyoutube=8Vql55afDcc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Introducing the Wargs[/h1]

Lately, the feline inhabitants of Murrlandia have not had an easy time. First, an archmage accidentally triggers armageddon, and then their planet’s geography dramatically changes as continents fractured and took to the skies. 

However, this was just the beginning as an aggressive race, known as the Wargs invaded. The Wargs, having destroyed their own planet, discovered Murrlandia and decided that this planet would be an ideal replacement. Unfortunately for the Meowkles, the Wargs wanted only the planet - not the inhabitants, and so the Meowkles found themselves fighting for their home and their lives.

What do these Wargs look like? An excellent question, and since our team has recently completed a lot of work on them, we’ve put this quick animated demonstration together.

[previewyoutube=gQ6HoyAdzLU;full][/previewyoutube]

For the development fans, here’s a look at how the Warg evolved overtime as your team developed it. 

[previewyoutube=M0Vu1dkL9y4;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]These Wargs are totally going to be a fur-midable opponent![/i]

[h1]Introducing Abilities[/h1]
As an (upcoming) Sandbox RPG, a big part of the game will be the ability system. After all, a big part of enjoying a game is getting to know the abilities, learning what the best and most powerful ones are, and seeing them executed in-game in all their animated goodness.

There are many ways for an ability system to work in games, so how does WorlsShards tackle this?

For this, let’s ask one of the residential Meokles!

[i]Meow, it’s time to look at the game! WorldShards does not have a normal ability system, nya!

Humans in Murrlandia seem to gain paw-tastic abilities from the very weapons that they equip. These abilities unlock the moment that the weapon is equipped, so make sure to get familiar with your weapon by training hard with it. Do that and I’m sure that you’ll go down in hiss-tory as a true meow-tastic hero![/i]

So here’s a look at an ability that you (the player) will get to use. What’s more, this is an ability that we’ve recently polished so you can see the old version and the new one side by side.

[previewyoutube=m7ahqhmcwcM;full][/previewyoutube]

And that's that for this update and look at WorldShards. Development continues to press ahead and we're going to enjoy sharing news and updates on our progress. If you're interested in WorldShards, make sure to check out [url=https://lowkick.games/]our website[/url], follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/WorldShardsGame]Twitter[/url], join us on [url=https://discord.gg/pyfCtJc93c]Discord[/url], and of course, join our community hub here on steam to become a member of our community!

notes.title: WorldShards Overview - Lore Preview, Races, and Game Features!
notes.content:
[h1]Lore - The World of WorldShards[/h1]

[h2]✨The Story So Far[/h2]
Murrlandia is a magical, mysterious world filled with dormant ancient magic, mysteries and dangers. A world full of flying islands soaring in the sky, divided by an endless void filled with invisible magical currents and insidious winds.

The original inhabitants of Murrlandia are the Meowkles, originally peaceful furry cat-like creatures who were once the only sentient inhabitants of this land.

But a terrible cat-aclysm (meow) split their planet into millions of pieces and put an end to their civilization. Now they cling to life on tiny islands floating over the ruined heart of their world, retaining only memories of their former prosperity and power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/1551cb5beb0d60a1b4fdb5e2b4995f2201d665d7.jpg[/img]

[h2]✨Races[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Meowkles[/b] — cute furry creatures — are the native inhabitants of Murrlandia. Usually, they live in groups on the biggest flying islands. They are engaged in agriculture, crafting and trade.
[*] [b]Monsters[/b] — A magical storm brought to Murrlandia many creatures the Meowkles had never seen before. Bloodthirsty monsters inhabited the wild islands. They always welcome uninvited guests - and a free lunch.
[*] [b]Wargs[/b] — Uninvited guests who appeared in Murrandia after the disaster. Their goal is to take over the fertile Murrlandia and relocate there from their poor and perishing planet. They do not consider peaceful coexistence with the inhabitants of the planet to be a worthy endeavour: why compromise when everything can be taken by force?
[*] [b]Humans[/b] — They, too, are uninvited guests in this world, having been snatched from their home world and brought to Murrlandia by the raging magic of the Mana Stones. Those who survived after being teleported to Murrlandia’s life-threatening islands had to become warriors, builders and explorers. Humans bravely conquer a new world full of mysteries and secrets. And it is up to them which role to take - to become saviours or cruel invaders.
[/list]

[h1]Game Features[/h1]

[h2]✨The World Now[/h2]
The world of Murrlandia has been shattered into pieces! You will travel to islands with different biomes, united in small archipelagos. To get from one island of the archipelago to another, you use the debris floating between them or your own wits - by solving a puzzle. On the wild islands, you will be able to gather resources, explore ancient ruins and interact with the monsters that live there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/4fe295e5664149b4d5c604e4d90f9f16b57eee0f.png[/img]

[h2]✨The Portals[/h2]
The portals will allow you to travel and explore wild shards! They can be found at your home shard. Even if they are activated without relics, using relics will still affect your portals. If you want to travel to a new shard with specific resources, you will need to use your relics wisely!

[h2]✨The Wild Shards[/h2]
The islands, also known as wild shards, are a product of procedural generation mixed with a caring human touch. Every shard will be different and will be made up of several biomes. They will contain new resources to gather, NPCs of all types with their own level of development, puzzles, secrets and a lot more! If you want to discover the story of Murrlandia, you will need to visit as many Shards as possible and solve its secrets and complete the quests!

[h2]✨Monster camps[/h2]
Settlements of wargs always contain a lot of valuable and interesting things.
You will always have a choice: try to defeat the monsters, get to the treasure unnoticed, or try to solve the problem peacefully, using the system of desires and relationships with monsters.
What will you choose?

[h2]✨Exploration[/h2]
As you explore the wild islands and search for resources, you will come across various interesting objects - landmarks. They will gradually tell you the story of WorldShards. Due to their number and variety, even the most active players will always find something new during their explorations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/9cb9ec69719ca45e563c02162ffd6fa12a10d8e3.jpg[/img]

[h2]✨The City[/h2]
After the cataclysm, the world split into shards and no city survived.  Humans decided to build a new one, which became the main city in Murrlandia. There you will be able to visit shops, start new quests, use the auction house, join a clan and make new friends!

And that’s not all, as the Bulletin Board will be waiting for you. Do you need wood? Process a rare stone on a high-level crafting station. If you cannot fulfil the quest's requirements, do not worry! Other players can help you with the quest and get rewarded accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/8d263b21f0fd8bafd677490fa5f519d5b2d32317.jpg[/img]

[h2]✨Living world - Wish system and relationships[/h2]
Murrlandia is a dynamic world with a life of its own. All its inhabitants have interests that you will be able to influence with your actions.

Not all creatures encountered in wild locations are hostile to you. Many can be neutral or even friendly. When you meet an intelligent creature, do not rush to draw your sword: you may have something in your inventory to help you establish contact.

The attitude of different groups and various monster tribes can vary depending on your actions - both locally and globally. Being good to everyone won’t work either! For example, do you remember that small tribe that you helped? That action may have provoked the other clan and made them your enemies. Also, how will some Meowkles feel when they know you have been helping the Wargs?

[h2]✨Auction House[/h2]
An auction is an important part of the game economy and the primary source of in-game currency. You will earn currency when selling resources and items to other players.
Any item you can find, craft, or otherwise obtain in the game can be sold or bought at the Auction House.

[h2]✨Social Life[/h2]
Once in the capital shard, you will be able to see other players that are spending time there too! You will be able to communicate with other players, find a team for adventures, make new friends, and much more. That is not all; you will also be able to create a clan, recruit mighty adventurers, invite friends and set up a clan island to access new co-op mechanics.

Alliances will be part of human life in Murrlandia as well. If you’re an achievement hunter —  completing social goals will unlock new achievements!

[h2]✨Equipment[/h2]
Although Meowkles are peaceful creatures, since the appearance of humans and monsters in Murrlandia, they have become well-versed in weapons. Smiths can share blueprints for various unusual weapons or equipment - for a fee. 
You will be able to use every type of weapon available in the game and build up different strategies for fighting the monsters. Using a smart combination of equipment items will grant you great bonuses that will make you stronger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/f7cb3a447ac210c50cce9dca0b72a9d97e5b28db.png[/img]

[h2]✨Crafting Stations[/h2]
You can build crafting stations and buildings on your home island using construction mode. The quality of the buildings can affect the crafting stations’ efficiency and grant buffs!

There are two types of Crafting stations:
[list]
[*] Refining Stations - used for refining basic materials.
[*] Crafting Stations - use your recipes to craft different items. From potions, consumables and gadgets to weapons and equipment. There are a lot of recipes to discover!
[/list]

That's all for today, if you like what you've read so far, then make sure to join our community, both here on Steam and over on our official [url=https://discord.gg/pyfCtJc93c]Discord server[/url], and naturally, if you have any questions about the game, the story, or our vision, ask away!

notes.title: Lore Spotlight - Welcome to the Fantasy World of Murrlandia
notes.content:
Hello there everyone!

We recently had a lovely surprise, though we silently launched WorldShards on Steam, the project was noticed by quite a lot of people which is amazing. 

With that said, this means that it’s time for us to pull up our sleeves, put on our thinking hats, and really begin to give you all some insight into our game. 

So without further ado, we’d like to once again welcome you all to WorldShards, and now dive into the story and lore of our game, starting with our original fantasy world of Murrlandia!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/54fbc386cdd7ac1be88deac4b72f3b7a237fd2cc.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to Murrlandia[/h1]
Murrlandia is the name of the world that we’ve created for WorldShards and in the current (in-game) day, is a peculiarity amongst worlds as it is made up of many islands that float in mid-air. 

Murrlandia was not always like this, in fact in the past it was a paradise planet, where the land was firmly on the ground, and the continents were separated by oceans and seas. It was a beautiful and vibrant planet, teeming with life; life dominated by the Meowkles.

[h1]The Meowkles[/h1]
The dominant species of Murrlandia were (and still are) the Meowkles, a curious cat-like species. Before the world was changed, the Meowkles lived in peace and prosperity: rivers were clean and never ran out of fish, the land was fertile, and crops constantly yielded a plentiful harvest.

So how did the planet change from a regular paradise planet to one dominated by floating islands?  To find out, we must look to the past. 

[h1]The Cat-a-strophe[/h1]
However, this ideal period of peace and prosperity was not to last. In a series of terrible luck, Murrlandia was struck by two disasters in short order. First, a cat-a-strophe struck, shattering the continents, and breaking them into islands. Not only that but the force of gravity on the planet was turned on its head and the islands levitated into the air. The lucky survivors were forced to become island-bound inhabitants, never leaving their island and surviving on increasingly scarce resources.

How did this happen? Little is known, but one thing is certain, the source of magic on Murrlandia, the Mana Stone, was the cause of the cat-a-strophe.

[h1]Magic and The Mana Stone[/h1]
The source of magic in Murrlandia was the Mana Stone and was studied by the Meowkles for centuries. Thanks to their studies, the technology of Murrlandia was heavily influenced by magic. Amazing mechanisms, magical potions, medicines, and more, were made possible because of the Mana Stone.

Unfortunately, something went horribly wrong and the Mana Stone was ultimately the cause of the cat-a-strophe.

[h1]The Invasion[/h1]
Soon after the cat-a-strophe, Murrlandia was invaded by a hyper-aggressive and brutal otherworldly force. Still recovering from the cat-a-strophe, the Meowkles found themselves at a huge disadvantage, and the invaders were able to establish a foothold on Murrlandia. Luckily, thanks to the Meowkle’s century-long studies of magic and the mana stone, and their natural agility, they were able to withstand some of the attacks and survive. However, the invasion did not stop with the first wave, more and more portals opened up, on Murrlandia, once again giving the invaders the edge.

Just as the situation looked its bleakest, a human appeared, seemingly teleported from a completely different world. The Meowkles instantly saw this human as the hero of legends and once again found hope in their hearts that they would be able to fight back against the invaders and someday in the near future, defeat the invaders entirely.

[h1]Current Day[/h1]
Though the Meowkles are the dominant species of Murrlandia, our protagonist is a human who was transported to Murrlandia (from modern-day Earth) by an unknown force. Now, they find themselves duty-bound to bring life to the Meowkle's legend of the hero, fight back against the invaders, and bring peace back to Murrlandia.

-

And that’s it for our (brief) overview of the history of Murrlandia and the Meowkles! Lore and story lovers, don’t worry, we’ll have more details for you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129713/8e7af69f1a99b6e9024b87e9df9a87db5c7149db.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to WorldShards
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Thank you for visiting the WorldShards Steam page, a sandbox RPG set in a fantasy world populated by the fuzzy Meowkles (yes we are big cat fans!).

But all is not well, a planetary catastrophe, combined with an invasion from a brutal otherworldly invader has shattered the world.

It will be up to you - the player - to bring life to the Meowkle's legend of the hero, fight back against the enemies, defeat the treacherous monster king, and bring peace back to the world.

The team from L1523kick Games are hard at work to bring you a deep and hugely enjoyable game, and we invite you all to join us on our game development journey!
